setup: CREATE TABLE stadium (stadium_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, location TEXT, name TEXT, capacity INTEGER, highest INTEGER, lowest INTEGER, average INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE singer (singer_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, country TEXT, song_name TEXT, song_release_year TEXT, age INTEGER, is_male TEXT)
CREATE TABLE concert (concert_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, concert_name TEXT, theme TEXT, stadium_id INTEGER, year TEXT)
CREATE TABLE singer_in_concert (concert_id INTEGER, singer_id INTEGER)

CREATE TABLE student (stuid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, lname TEXT, fname TEXT, age INTEGER, sex TEXT, major INTEGER, advisor INTEGER, city_code TEXT)
CREATE TABLE pets (petid INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, pettype TEXT, pet_age INTEGER, weight REAL)
CREATE TABLE has_pet (stuid INTEGER, petid INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE course (course_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, staring_date TEXT, course TEXT)
CREATE TABLE teacher (teacher_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, age INTEGER, hometown TEXT)
CREATE TABLE course_arrange (course_id INTEGER, teacher_id INTEGER, grade INTEGER)

tasks.question: How many singers are in the database?
For each country, show the country and the number of singers from it, ordered by the number of singers descending.
tasks.gold: SELECT country, count(*) FROM singer GROUP BY country ORDER BY count(*) DESC

tasks.question: What are the names of the stadiums that have hosted more than one concert?
tasks.gold: SELECT T2.name FROM concert AS T1 JOIN stadium AS T2 ON T1.stadium_id = T2.stadium_id GROUP BY T1.stadium_id HAVING count(*) > 1

tasks.question: What is the average age of the dogs?
tasks.gold: SELECT avg(pet_age) FROM pets WHERE pettype = 'dog'

tasks.question: What are the first names of the students who own a cat?
tasks.gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fname FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid = T2.stuid JOIN pets AS T3 ON T2.petid = T3.petid WHERE T3.pettype = 'cat'

tasks.question: What is the hometown of the youngest teacher?
tasks.gold: SELECT hometown FROM teacher ORDER BY age ASC LIMIT 1

tasks.question: Show the names of the teachers who teach more than one course.
tasks.gold: SELECT T2.name FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN teacher AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id = T2.teacher_id GROUP BY T1.teacher_id HAVING count(*) > 1

tasks.question: List the names of the courses taught by the teacher named Joseph Huts.
tasks.gold: SELECT T3.course FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN teacher AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id = T2.teacher_id JOIN course AS T3 ON T1.course_id = T3.course_id WHERE T2.name = 'Joseph Huts'
